scope: Exercise the public AC1018 writeTableWithLegacySourcePresence route under callback-local allocation failure in ASCII and Binary.

source.profile: One generated one-column, one-row ACAD_TABLE using a one-byte zero legacy source-presence mask; no external or committed fixture is used.

implementation.method: Calibrate allocations scoped around writeTableWithLegacySourcePresence and inject one-shot bad_alloc at every measured offset. Require whole fileExport refusal, unchanged source identities and TABLE body, prior destination preservation, same-adapter retry producing byte-identical clean output, and fresh typed TABLE readback. The outer file operation is authoritative for refusal because some caught serializer failures leave the callback's emitted flag set while the writer's sticky error prevents publication.

validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 11/11 and Binary 11/11 allocation offsets reached

limitations: Generated AC1018 transaction and typed-readback evidence only; source-specific legacy spelling semantics, producer prevalence and native TABLE behavior remain separate gates.
Only the one-cell zero source-presence mask is covered; nonzero masks, block-cell source presence, attributes, merged cells and other TABLE payloads are not covered here.
P6-G remains open pending the public-writer inventory and other uncovered transaction profiles.
